subtitle: Private offline practice
promotional_text: A quiet practice teacher for walking, breathing, and private reflection — fully offline.
description: Morrow Steps is a private, fully offline practice teacher for small moments of attention. Follow Walk for a four-step return to the room, use Four Columns for a rising-column breath, choose a practice range, and write a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your preferences and notes stay on your device.
app_review_notes: Morrow Steps is a fully offline attention-practice and private-journal app. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four guidance steps, start Four Columns breathing, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
